mapper.select: SELECT b.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit, m.ref_cost FROM ecom_bundle_item b LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = b.material_id WHERE b.listing_id IN #{id} ORDER BY b.listing_id, b.sort, b.id
mapper.insert:
